ChoAuth._comment: Development-only trust. Symmetric keys are refused on any host other than Development/Testing. Deployed environments configure asymmetric keys from Key Vault (see docs/security/portal-token-service.md).

SmartAuth._comment: The bundled smart-auth-service issues no tenant claim (it has no reliable user-to-tenant mapping), so its Demo issuer is confined to the one development tenant; that tenant becomes its tokens tenant. Never a header.
